posts.text: Humans vote with their feet. There are an estimated 500,000 diaspora Iranians who call the United Arab Emirates home. There are virtually no Emiratis living in the Islamic Republic of Iran. The greatest admirers of revolutionary dictatorships are those who don't live under them.

Trump signals to markets the war may soon end, while warning Tehran it could soon return.

Tehran signals to both the US and its own population that—despite enormous economic duress—it remains defiant. 

Power in Iran is now diffuse. 

CNN w @jessicadean
